subject.title: feat: per-channel debounce/cap/drop queue options (mode already supported)

question: What public config shape should OpenClaw support for per-channel queue cap/drop settings while preserving the existing string-valued `messages.queue.byChannel` mode map?
rationale: The remaining behavior is not a broken current contract; it adds new queue config surface in an area where AGENTS.md and VISION.md require deliberate config-shape and compatibility decisions.

options.title: Add sibling maps
options.body: Add additive fields such as `capByChannel` and `dropByChannel`, matching `debounceMsByChannel` and avoiding a migration of existing `byChannel` mode configs.

options.title: Reshape `byChannel`
options.body: Allow object values under `byChannel` only with an explicit doctor migration and compatibility decision for existing string-valued mode configs.

options.title: Keep cap/drop global
options.body: Document that burst sizing and overflow policy remain global or per-session only, leaving per-channel tuning limited to mode and debounce.

recommendation.title: Add sibling maps
recommendation.body: Add additive fields such as `capByChannel` and `dropByChannel`, matching `debounceMsByChannel` and avoiding a migration of existing `byChannel` mode configs.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced per-channel debounce and have the strongest history on the queue resolver/config/docs contract.
